[2:57PM] #EbuteEro #Apongbon #TrafficUpdate 

There is slow and steady movement along the CMS Bridge inward Offin Canal Market, largely due to market activities and the constant in-and-out vehicular movement around the market axis. In addition, the slow descent of a lowbed truck convoy from CMS Bridge toward Offin Canal is contributing to delays in that stretch. However, traffic flow improves immediately after Offin Canal Market, with a smooth ride through to Ijora Olopa by the NEPA intersection.

Broad Street traffic remains steady from its stretch down to Apongbon, underneath the bridge, providing easy connection to Offin Canal Market and Olowogbowo. Similarly, the Eko Bridge inward Apongbon linking CMS Bridge, Elegbeta, and CFAO is in good condition with no major obstructions.

Traffic descending Idumota Bridge inward Ebute-Ero Market, through Leventis and UBA Roundabout to connect both inner and outer Marina, is also moving well. At present, there are no significant impediments, and our personnel are on ground ensuring smooth traffic management.

Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 8 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at: 11:00 PM, 05 September 2025(Friday)

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Zambales.
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, expect light to moderate rains over Bulacan, Nueva Ecija, Metro Manila, Cavite and Batangas within the next 3 hours.
Light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Bataan, Pampanga and Tarlac which may persist within 3 hours.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 2:00 AM tomorrow.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZJq1n.
